title: Jamie Burkart portfolio production readiness
objective: Make the portfolio clear, inspectable, public-safe, application-ready, and production-safe without overstating Jamie's role or exposing protected material.
hard_constraints: Do not publish private source material, raw transcripts, private correspondence, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, credentials, or private records.
Do not strengthen ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current-status claims beyond the knowledge bank.
Preserve collective credit and collaborator-sensitive guardrails.
Do not display Jamie's phone number in website HTML; it may remain in the approved resume PDF.
Do not represent Source-Backed Team Memory as finished production SaaS or automated trust.
Do not delete useful public content, routes, evidence, or accessibility affordances merely to improve a score.
Do not flatten artistic, relational, hospitable, embodied, or experimental practice into organizational utility merely because it is harder to quantify or hire from.

Do not turn historical coursework into claims that Jamie currently practices social-network research, invented structural equivalence, solely authored collaborative installations, or resolved an archival title conflict.
Do not deploy to production or enable indexing without Jamie's explicit approval of the exact candidate.

evals.title: Two-minute application comprehension
procedure: Give three blind judges no context beyond the candidate URLs.
Allow each judge two minutes of reading.
Ask each judge to identify Jamie's target role, central value, three proof examples, and the next action they would take.
pass_criteria: At least two of three judges identify Technical Project Manager, Product Operations, or Implementation as the role family.
At least two of three judges describe the central promise as creating operating structure for complex or emerging work still taking shape.
At least two of three judges name three accurate project proofs without inventing government employment, official authority, or solo policy causality.
No unexplained employer-specific acronym or application-specific phrase interrupts the general hiring path.
Median score is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Improve first-viewport positioning, proof hierarchy, and application-path links before adding more copy.

evals.title: Inspectable evidence on lead work
procedure: Inventory visible figures, screenshots, diagrams, downloads, and public artifacts.
Verify each artifact's caption, provenance, alt text, consent status, and relation to a claim.
Have a blind judge explain what each artifact proves.
pass_criteria: Each lead page contains at least one genuine inspectable artifact, not only a styled descriptive card.
Every visual has useful alt text, a caption, a source or ownership note, and public-safety approval.
The homepage or Technical Operations page links to at least three inspectable proof objects.
A judge can connect each artifact to a specific action, outcome, or operating capability.
evals.remediation_hint: Curate a small set of public-safe artifacts before adding additional case-study prose.

evals.title: Role-fit claims trace to projects and outcomes
procedure: Review each capability section.
Trace the capability to a named project, Jamie's action, an artifact or observable outcome, and a deeper link.
pass_criteria: Every primary capability has a project, action, evidence, and destination link.
Generic descriptions of desired job duties do not substitute for proof.
The page supports at least three common application narratives without becoming employer-specific.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace generic capability language with compact project-action-result rows.

evals.title: Voice, compression, and reading burden
procedure: Judge the copy for warmth, precision, civic and relational awareness, structural clarity, and claim discipline.
Identify repeated claims, internal editorial scaffolding, and sections that explain what an artifact could show instead of showing it.
pass_criteria: Each lead page establishes context, Jamie's action, and outcome within the first 250 words.
No adjacent sections repeat the same central claim without adding evidence or consequence.
Public copy sounds warm and precise rather than corporate, defensive, or overqualified.
Language treats ambiguity, emergence, and transition as normal conditions of change rather than evidence of dysfunction or shame.
Governance language supports trust without dominating the hiring narrative.
evals.remediation_hint: Let artifacts carry proof, shorten repeated explanation, and move detailed governance to concise scope notes.

evals.title: Claim governance and public safety
procedure: Run knowledge-bank, citation, and public-safety checks.
Trace every metric-bearing or strong claim to an approved proof record.
Review careful claims for contribution, stewardship, collective credit, and protected boundaries.
pass_criteria: All deterministic claim and public-safety checks pass.
Every strong public claim resolves to an approved proof record and source basis.
No public page strengthens ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current status.
No protected source material or unapproved collaborator material is published.
evals.remediation_hint: Soften or remove the public projection; never manufacture a stronger proof.

evals.title: Resume artifact readiness
procedure: Extract resume text and render every page.
Check links, page count, clipping, text density, role positioning, phone policy, and credential wording.
pass_criteria: The PDF is two pages or fewer, machine-readable, visually intact, and uses the approved phone number.
Phone is absent from website HTML.
Portfolio, email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and cited public links resolve correctly.
The top third communicates role, value, and strongest relevant proof.
AI Evals coursework is framed as professional development, not instructor affiliation or certification authority.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the approved artifact or its delivery path without exposing phone data in HTML.

evals.title: CTA labels match their actions
procedure: Inventory CTA labels, hrefs, download attributes, and final destinations.
Exercise primary application and contact paths.
pass_criteria: A CTA labeled Download resume points to the PDF and initiates or clearly reaches a PDF download.
A CTA pointing to the resume HTML page is labeled View resume or equivalent.
Email, contact, work, and case-study actions have truthful labels and no dead ends.
All primary actions are reachable by keyboard.
evals.remediation_hint: Change the label or destination so the visible promise matches the resulting action.

evals.title: Indexing, canonical, and sitemap consistency
procedure: Check headers and metadata for every canonical route in staging and production mode.
Compare robots directives, sitemap membership, canonical URLs, and PDF behavior.
pass_criteria: Staging disallows crawling and emits noindex, nofollow headers.
Production HTML routes intended for discovery are indexable and canonicalize to jamieburk.art.
The resume HTML page is not simultaneously present in the sitemap and blocked by an X-Robots-Tag header.
The phone-bearing resume PDF remains noindex unless Jamie explicitly changes that policy.
The sitemap contains no route blocked from indexing and no staging URL.
Sitemap last-modified values are stable content dates or are omitted; they do not change merely because the sitemap was requested.
evals.remediation_hint: Align route-specific headers, metadata, and sitemap membership before cutover.

evals.title: Build, route, and runtime integrity
procedure: Run npm check, staging preflight, and production preflight serially.
Build and run the production Docker image.
Smoke every canonical route, health endpoint, robots file, sitemap, and resume PDF.
Inspect browser console output.
pass_criteria: All repository and environment preflights pass.
The production Docker image builds and runs as a non-root user.
Every canonical route returns the expected success status and content type.
No uncaught browser-console errors appear on primary routes.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the smallest failing contract and re-run the complete deterministic suite serially.

evals.title: Responsive and accessible use
inputs: all canonical routes at 320, 375, 768, and 1280 pixel widths
procedure: Capture responsive screenshots and measure document overflow.
Test landmarks, heading order, keyboard focus, link purpose, contrast, reduced motion, and image alternatives.
pass_criteria: No canonical route has horizontal page overflow at supported widths.
No text, navigation, or CTA overlaps or clips.
Keyboard users can reach and identify every primary action.
There are no critical accessibility violations.
Every meaningful image has useful alternative text and decorative images are ignored appropriately.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the shared component or responsive constraint causing the broadest failure first.

evals.title: Production cutover preserves the public system
procedure: Verify the production app, domains, TLS, build arguments, runtime environment, redirect behavior, and rollback target.
Run post-deploy smoke tests against the public domains.
pass_criteria: jamieburk.art serves the reviewed portfolio candidate over TLS.
www redirects once to the canonical apex URL.
npr.jamieburk.art remains available and is not unintentionally overwritten.
Production health reports the production URL and indexable state.
A documented rollback can restore the prior routing or release.
evals.remediation_hint: Treat cutover as a bounded release with explicit routing, exact commit, smoke tests, and rollback.

evals.title: Approval and launch ledger is authoritative
procedure: Reconcile approvals and blockers into one current go or no-go record.
Ask Jamie to approve the exact candidate commit, public contact path, resume artifact, metrics, and new collaborator-sensitive artifacts.
pass_criteria: The approval register and launch ledger do not contradict each other.
Every new screenshot, photograph, quote, credit, or collaborator-sensitive artifact has recorded approval.
Jamie explicitly approves the exact production candidate and indexing state.
evals.remediation_hint: Stop and request human review; an LLM cannot satisfy this gate.

evals.title: AI and source-backed memory claims are demonstrated and bounded
procedure: Verify the course-completion evidence and wording.
Inspect one synthetic or public-safe worked example of the Known, Open, Protected method.
pass_criteria: Course completion is visible and accurately attributed as professional development.
The lab includes one inspectable public-safe or synthetic worked example.
The page does not imply production SaaS, automated trust, client delivery, or access to private archives.
evals.remediation_hint: Show a bounded example and preserve the method's human-review and privacy limits.

evals.title: Application packet coherence
procedure: Give a blind judge the role brief and complete application packet without optimization history.
Ask the judge to identify Jamie's fit, the strongest supporting proof, any contradiction or unexplained claim, and the next action invited by the packet.
pass_criteria: The primary portfolio link leads to the clearest role-fit page rather than a generic index.
Two supporting case studies are selected for the target role and demonstrate distinct capabilities.
The application note is four sentences or comparably concise and states the role, operating problem, relevant proof, and direct invitation to speak.
Role titles, dates, metrics, links, and claim boundaries remain consistent across the note, resume, and site.
A production packet contains no staging URL, draft language, internal editorial instruction, or unexplained employer-specific shorthand.
evals.remediation_hint: Tailor selection and sequence before adding claims; keep one role, three proof surfaces, and one clear next action.

evals.title: Courageous precision under Chad's lens
procedure: Read the homepage and Technical Operations page once, without private archive context or optimization history.
For the lead promise and every featured work card, identify Jamie as actor, the concrete action, the end served, and what became usable.
Compare strong accomplishment language with the knowledge bank and its collective-credit and causality guardrails.
Ask a blind judge to state Jamie's role family and three defensible accomplishments without decoding internal portfolio language.
pass_criteria: The first viewport names Jamie's role, makes Jamie the actor, and names concrete outputs rather than relying on generic systems language.
Every featured work summary makes Jamie's contribution grammatically visible and states a concrete action, output, beneficiary, or outcome.
The strongest approved metrics and accomplishments are presented directly enough to support referral or interview decisions.
Collective work uses co-built, co-founded, contributed, helped, supported, hosted, or stewarded language where required by the knowledge bank.
No sentence inflates ownership, causality, official authority, legal authority, current status, or scale beyond its approved proof record.
A blind judge identifies the role family and at least three accurate accomplishments in one pass, reports no material decoding burden, and scores the criterion at least 3.
evals.remediation_hint: Make Jamie and the useful end visible, replace vague nouns with named work and outputs, and strengthen only to the boundary already supported by the proof bank.

evals.title: Embodied systems and media archaeology under Margaret Morse's lens
procedure: Read the portfolio for the Jamie it rewards and identify whether useful operations work has displaced artistic investigation, hospitality, atmosphere, material attention, or relationships.
Find one restrained public threshold where Jamie's artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain visibly connected.
Trace that connection through at least one concrete embodied or media-archaeological work and explain how it informs structures people can inhabit rather than merely procedures they must follow.
Verify the historical source, collaborator credit, archival uncertainty, and the distinction between supported accomplishment and present-day role positioning.
pass_criteria: A secondary hiring surface preserves a visible connection among artistic, civic, technical, and social practice without displacing the first-viewport Technical Project Manager argument.
The connection names a concrete historical experiment, material, interface, or installation rather than relying on generic creativity language.
The copy makes participation, memory, place, attention, or inhabitation professionally legible without reducing their value to organizational efficiency.
Margaret Morse's contemporaneous assessment is represented as protected source support, not republished raw evaluation or private correspondence.
The site does not claim uninterrupted professional art practice, sole authorship, resolved title variants, or present-day media-production specialization.
A blind hiring reader can explain how the earlier embodied practice changes the quality of Jamie's current systems work and scores the criterion at least 3.
evals.remediation_hint: Add one concrete, source-backed threshold on About or Technical Operations that connects embodied artistic inquiry to participation, memory, place, and inhabitable systems; keep the homepage role signal unchanged.

evals.title: Original social-software reasoning under Warren Sack's lens
procedure: Trace at least one source-backed sequence from a latent social pattern through analysis, prototype, interactive interface, explanation, and collaborative form.
Check whether the portfolio makes Jamie's original reasoning visible rather than presenting him only as the operator of requirements created by others.
Verify that technical and artistic complexity, evidence-supported analysis, classroom communication, and shared project credit remain distinct accomplishments.
Ask a blind hiring reader to explain the relevance of the historical prototype to current technical project management, product operations, or implementation work.
pass_criteria: A public-safe surface names a specific early social-software or interactive prototype and the latent structure it made usable.
The reader can follow the movement from observation to computational model to interface or collaborative experience.
The portfolio presents Jamie as capable of originating a model, prototyping it, communicating it, and contributing it to shared work, not only administering delivery.
Warren Sack's contemporaneous assessment remains protected source support and is not stretched into current research authority or commercial deployment.
The copy does not say Jamie invented structural equivalence, solely designed the collaborative installation, or operates the historical prototypes today.
A blind hiring reader can connect this evidence to present-day systems judgment without losing the portfolio's primary role category and scores the criterion at least 3.
evals.remediation_hint: Name one specific observation-model-interface sequence and connect it to current systems judgment, while retaining historical scope, collaborative credit, and anti-invention boundaries.
